summary: Iteration 37 — Bulk Rediscover feature. Backend + Frontend fully verified end-to-end. All 12 review scenarios pass (audit-log endpoint absent → skipped as spec allows).
backend_verified: POST /api/admin/market/sources/rediscover-all returns schema {total,with_changes,no_changes,errored,skipped,diffs[]} — 8/8 assertions pass. Buckets sum to total.
Hausples PNG diff: ok=true; suggested contains BOTH https://www.hausples.com.pg/buy/ AND https://www.hausples.com.pg/rent/; no legacy /property-for-sale or /property-for-rent paths.

PUT /api/admin/market/sources/{sid}/listing-pages: 404 for unknown sid, 400 for non-list body, 200+persistence for valid single entry (verbatim URL), 200+cleared listing_pages for empty list. Original data restored after test.
Graceful degradation: unreachable sources (Strickland, the professionals, LJ Hooker PNG) surface as ok=false with non-null error strings; the request itself still returns 200 with the full diff list.
Audit-log endpoint /api/admin/market/audit-log not implemented (returns 404) — test skipped as review request allowed.
frontend_verified: rediscover-all-btn visible next to add-source-btn on /admin/market/sources.
bulk-rediscover-modal opens with header, close btn, and initial Run scan button.

bulk-rediscover-run triggers scan; 9 per-source rows (rediscover-row-{sid}) rendered; all 5 summary pills (sum-total=9, sum-changed=1→0 after apply, sum-nochange=3, sum-errored=3, sum-skipped=2) show with numbers.
Expand diff: rediscover-toggle-{sid} for Hausples row opens rediscover-detail-{sid} listing 12 URLs including /buy/ and /rent/ verbatim.
Apply single (MarketMeri row): rediscover-apply-{sid} click → toast, apply button disappears (count 0), row status flips to 'Unchanged'.
bulk-rediscover-rerun replaces report with a fresh scan; no JS console errors captured.
bulk-rediscover-close hides modal (count=0); Sources page remains functional (add-source-btn still visible).
Regression: add-source-btn opens Add Source modal; inspect-source-{id} button present (was blocked in test only because Add Source modal stayed open, not a product defect).
critical_code_review_comments: Optional (not blocking): Consider adding GET /api/admin/market/audit-log to expose the audit trail written by 'sources_rediscover_all' and 'source_listing_pages_updated' — currently entries are stored but not queryable via API in this build.

Naming inconsistency observation: DB source seeded as 'Hausples PNG' (base_url https://www.hausples.com.pg) renders in the modal alongside another source 'Hausples' (base_url https://hausples.com.pg). Only one appears in the rediscover modal (the base_url without www). Worth confirming there's not a duplicate seed.
seed_data_creation: None. Applied a temporary /buy/ listing_pages to Hausples PNG then restored the original list within the test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter37 introduces POST /admin/market/sources/rediscover-all (parallel fan-out, sem=3) and PUT /admin/market/sources/{sid}/listing-pages (full REPLACE, no merge). Some real sites (Strickland, the professionals, LJ Hooker PNG) are unreachable from this env — that manifests as ok=false + error string and is EXPECTED graceful degradation. Backend test file /app/backend/tests/test_iter37_bulk_rediscover.py takes ~42s (external HTTP fan-out). Frontend Sources modal correctly displays 5 summary pills, 9 rows, expandable per-source diff detail, per-row Apply, Apply-all-changed, Re-run scan, Close.
